description: Create the markets API router structure
steps: Create src/prediction_data/api/markets/ directory
Create __init__.py, router.py, service.py, schemas.py files
Register markets router in api/main.py with prefix /api/v1/markets
Add 'markets' tag to router for OpenAPI grouping

description: Define Pydantic schemas for market data matching frontend expectations
steps: Create MarketOutcome schema with fields: id (str), tokenId (str), outcomeName (str), currentPrice (float), volume (float)

Create MarketBase schema with fields: id (str), polymarketId (str), conditionId (str | None), slug (str | None), question (str), description (str | None), category (str | None), endDate (str | None), resolved (bool), totalVolume (float), liquidity (float), createdAt (str), imageUrl (str | None)
Create MarketResponse schema extending MarketBase with outcomes: list[MarketOutcome]

Create MarketAdvancedResponse extending MarketResponse with CLOB fields: bid (float | None), ask (float | None), spread (float | None), spreadPercent (float | None), spreadCents (float | None), volume24h (float), priceChange24h (float)
Create MarketListResponse with items: list[MarketResponse], total: int, page: int, limit: int
Create MarketAdvancedListResponse with items: list[MarketAdvancedResponse], total: int, page: int, limit: int

Create TradeResponse schema with fields: id (str), traderAddress (str), marketId (str), outcomeId (str), outcomeName (str), side (Literal['BUY', 'SELL']), price (float), amount (float), usdValue (float), txHash (str), timestamp (str)
Create PriceHistoryPoint schema with fields: timestamp (str), price (float), volume (float)
Create MarketFilters schema for query params: category (str | None), search (str | None), resolved (bool | None), limit (int = 50), offset (int = 0)
Implement GET /markets endpoint in router.py
Accept query params: category, search, resolved, limit (default 50, max 500), offset (default 0)
Query ClickHouse dim_market table for market data
Join with dim_outcome for outcome details
Apply filters: category exact match, search ILIKE on question/description, resolved boolean
Order by totalVolume DESC as default
Return MarketListResponse with pagination metadata
Add service function get_markets() that builds and executes ClickHouse query

description: Markets with CLOB bid/ask data for advanced filtering
steps: Implement GET /markets/advanced endpoint

Accept extended query params: category, sortBy (volume, liquidity, spread, priceChange), minVolume, maxVolume, minLiquidity, maxLiquidity, minSpread, maxSpread, timeRemaining, createdDate, minChange, maxChange, tags (comma-separated), limit, offset, page
Query ClickHouse for base market data
For each market, fetch real-time CLOB data from Polymarket CLOB API (batch request if possible)
CLOB API: GET https://clob.polymarket.com/book with token_id parameter
Extract best bid/ask from order book response
Calculate spread = ask - bid, spreadPercent = spread / midpoint * 100, spreadCents = spread * 100
Apply advanced filters on computed fields (spread, priceChange, etc.)
Return MarketAdvancedListResponse
Handle CLOB API rate limits (500 req/10s) - batch requests, add delays if needed
Cache CLOB data for 30-60 seconds to reduce API calls
Implement GET /markets/screener endpoint
Accept query params: timeWindow (enum: 6h, 12h, 24h, 7d), minVolume, maxVolume, minPriceChange, maxPriceChange, category, resolved, sortBy (volume, priceChange), sortOrder (asc, desc), limit, offset
Query ClickHouse market_mark_daily for historical price data
Calculate price change over the specified time window
Calculate volume over the time window
Filter by computed price change and volume ranges
Return MarketAdvancedListResponse with computed fields
Implement GET /markets/{id} endpoint
Accept market_id as path parameter (can be internal ID, polymarketId, or slug)
Query ClickHouse dim_market with flexible ID matching
Include full outcome details with current prices
Optionally fetch real-time CLOB bid/ask for the market
Return MarketResponse or MarketAdvancedResponse based on include_clob query param
Return 404 if market not found
Implement GET /markets/{id}/trades endpoint
Accept path param: market_id
Accept query params: limit (default 100, max 1000), offset, startDate, endDate
Query ClickHouse trades table (Silver layer polymarket/trades or wallet_position_ledger)
Filter by market_id
Order by timestamp DESC (most recent first)
Include trader address, side, price, amount, outcome name
Return list of TradeResponse with pagination
Implement GET /markets/{id}/price-history endpoint
Accept path param: market_id
Accept query params: interval (enum: 1h, 4h, 1d, 1w), startDate, endDate, outcomeId (optional, defaults to YES outcome)
Query ClickHouse market_mark_daily for historical price marks
Aggregate by the specified interval
Return list of PriceHistoryPoint with timestamp, price, volume
Ensure chronological order (oldest first) for chart rendering
Create src/prediction_data/api/events/ directory with router.py, service.py, schemas.py
Register events router in api/main.py with prefix /api/v1/events
Create EventResponse schema: id (str), polymarketEventId (str), title (str), description (str | None), slug (str), status (str), category (str | None), markets (list[MarketBase])
Create EventListResponse with items, total, page, limit
Implement GET /events endpoint
Accept query params: category, search, status, limit, offset
Query ClickHouse dim_event table
Include associated markets count or basic market info
Return EventListResponse
Implement GET /events/{id} endpoint
Query ClickHouse dim_event by ID or slug
Include full list of associated markets with outcomes
Return EventResponse with nested markets
Return 404 if event not found
Create src/prediction_data/api/tags/ directory or add to markets router
Create TagResponse schema: id (str), name (str), slug (str), marketCount (int)
Implement GET /tags endpoint
Query distinct tags from markets (may need to extract from market metadata)
Return list of TagResponse ordered by marketCount DESC
Create src/prediction_data/api/clickhouse.py with query utilities
Create async wrapper around clickhouse_connect client
Add query builder helpers for common patterns (pagination, filtering, sorting)
Add connection pooling or singleton pattern for client reuse
Handle query timeouts (5-10 second default)
Add query result to Pydantic model conversion helpers

description: Create Polymarket CLOB API client for real-time data
steps: Create src/prediction_data/api/clob_client.py
Implement async function to fetch order book for a token_id
Implement batch fetching for multiple token_ids
Add rate limiting (max 500 req/10s)
Add response caching with TTL (30-60 seconds)
Extract best bid/ask from order book levels
Handle API errors gracefully (return None for failed fetches)

description: Update frontend hooks to call new backend endpoints
steps: Update web/src/hooks/useMarkets.ts to call /api/v1/markets
Update web/src/hooks/useMarketsAdvanced.ts to call /api/v1/markets/advanced
Update any market detail fetching to use /api/v1/markets/{id}
Update price history fetching for charts
Remove or deprecate old Prisma-based data fetching in hooks
Update React Query keys to match new endpoint structure

description: Regenerate OpenAPI spec with new endpoints
steps: Run python scripts/export_openapi.py after adding all endpoints
Verify openapi.json includes all market, event, and tag endpoints
Verify all schemas are properly documented
Run npm run generate-api in web/ to regenerate TypeScript types
Verify generated types match expected frontend interfaces
